  `lib/apps|gemma|webllm|transformers_js|l10n/`. All lib-internal imports
  are absolute `package:fa/...` — no relative imports.
## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`

blocks.text:
- `flutter_app/` — Flutter chat example. Layout: `lib/main.dart`
  (entrypoint + BootstrapScreen: auto-connects the restored last connection
  when its key resolves, else SetupScreen), `lib/ui/` (`app_theme.dart` —
  shim re-exporting the fa_ui theme; `markdown_style.dart`, `screens/`,
  `widgets/`),
  `lib/services/` (agent service, stores, upload, secrets, project mount,
  vision, `theme_controller.dart` theme-mode persistence + `FahThemeScope`;
  `session_keys_store.dart`/`keychain_store.dart`/`provider_registry.dart`/
  `media_models_store.dart`/`vision_models.dart` are shim re-exports of the
  fa_ui stores), `lib/sandbox/` (env,
  shells, wasm, git, fs persistence), feature dirs
  `lib/apps|gemma|webllm|transformers_js|l10n/`. All lib-internal imports
  are absolute `package:fa/...` — no relative imports.
## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.

   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`

- `flutter_app/` — Flutter chat example. Layout: `lib/main.dart`
  (entrypoint + BootstrapScreen: auto-connects the restored last connection
  when its key resolves, else SetupScreen), `lib/ui/` (`app_theme.dart` —
  shim re-exporting the fa_ui theme; `markdown_style.dart`, `screens/`,
  `widgets/`),
  `lib/services/` (agent service, stores, upload, secrets, project mount,
  vision, `theme_controller.dart` theme-mode persistence + `FahThemeScope`;
  `session_keys_store.dart`/`keychain_store.dart`/`provider_registry.dart`/
  `media_models_store.dart`/`vision_models.dart` are shim re-exports of the
  fa_ui stores), `lib/sandbox/` (env,
  shells, wasm, git, fs persistence), feature dirs
  `lib/apps|gemma|webllm|transformers_js|l10n/`. All lib-internal imports
  are absolute `package:fa/...` — no relative imports.
## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`

- `flutter_app/` — Flutter chat example. Layout: `lib/main.dart`
  (entrypoint + BootstrapScreen: auto-connects the restored last connection
  when its key resolves, else SetupScreen), `lib/ui/` (`app_theme.dart` —
  shim re-exporting the fa_ui theme; `markdown_style.dart`, `screens/`,
  `widgets/`),
  `lib/services/` (agent service, stores, upload, secrets, project mount,
  vision, `theme_controller.dart` theme-mode persistence + `FahThemeScope`;
  `session_keys_store.dart`/`keychain_store.dart`/`provider_registry.dart`/
  `media_models_store.dart`/`vision_models.dart` are shim re-exports of the
  fa_ui stores), `lib/sandbox/` (env,
  shells, wasm, git, fs persistence), feature dirs
  `lib/apps|gemma|webllm|transformers_js|l10n/`. All lib-internal imports
  are absolute `package:fa/...` — no relative imports.
## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`

# Thread 1 — ⚠️ IMPORTANT → probe gap: live-tile entries are not bootability-checked

**Fixed.** `listApps` now probes every launch surface's boot entry, the live-tile one included:

- New `AppsStore._missingBootEntry(id, {tileEntry})` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) probes `AppStorage.entryPath(id)` (the full-app entry) **and**, when the parsed model declares a `"widget"` section, `AppStorage.entryPath(id, tileWidget.entry)` — the exact path `AppTileHost` boots (`app.tileWidgetPath`). The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).
- Both scan paths are covered: the fresh-parse path probes against the parsed model, and the **manifest-hash cache-hit path** now probes the tile entry via `cached.tileWidget` too — a tile entry lost *after* a clean scan still flags on the next scan.
- A manifest declaring an entry that cannot resolve in the namespace (`"entry": "../evil.js"`) is flagged as unbootable instead of letting the resolver `ArgumentError` crash the whole listing.

Regression tests (`test/apps/app_namespace_it_test.dart`, group `gh-1614 I2/I3`):

- `a torn live-tile app (entry present, tile entry lost) lists the missing-files state naming the tile path` — failed before the fix (`error` was null).
- `the tile entry vanishing after a clean scan flags the tile on the next scan (cache-hit path)` — failed before the fix.
- `a live-tile app with both entries present lists clean` — guards over-flagging.
- `a live-tile entry name that cannot resolve in the namespace flags the tile instead of crashing the listing`.

# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

**Fixed.** `listApps` now probes every launch surface's boot entry, the live-tile one included:

- New `AppsStore._missingBootEntry(id, {tileEntry})` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) probes `AppStorage.entryPath(id)` (the full-app entry) **and**, when the parsed model declares a `"widget"` section, `AppStorage.entryPath(id, tileWidget.entry)` — the exact path `AppTileHost` boots (`app.tileWidgetPath`). The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).
- Both scan paths are covered: the fresh-parse path probes against the parsed model, and the **manifest-hash cache-hit path** now probes the tile entry via `cached.tileWidget` too — a tile entry lost *after* a clean scan still flags on the next scan.
- A manifest declaring an entry that cannot resolve in the namespace (`"entry": "../evil.js"`) is flagged as unbootable instead of letting the resolver `ArgumentError` crash the whole listing.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).
- Both scan paths are covered: the fresh-parse path probes against the parsed model, and the **manifest-hash cache-hit path** now probes the tile entry via `cached.tileWidget` too — a tile entry lost *after* a clean scan still flags on the next scan.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

{"content":"# Thread 1 — ⚠️ IMPORTANT → probe gap: live-tile entries are not bootability-checked

**Fixed.** `listApps` now probes every launch surface's boot entry, the live-tile one included:

- New `AppsStore._missingBootEntry(id, {tileEntry})` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) probes `AppStorage.entryPath(id)` (the full-app entry) **and**, when the parsed model declares a `"widget"` section, `AppStorage.entryPath(id, tileWidget.entry)` — the exact path `AppTileHost` boots (`app.tileWidgetPath`). The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).
- Both scan paths are covered: the fresh-parse path probes against the parsed model, and the **manifest-hash cache-hit path** now probes the tile entry via `cached.tileWidget` too — a tile entry lost *after* a clean scan still flags on the next scan.
- A manifest declaring an entry that cannot resolve in the namespace (`"entry": "../evil.js"`) is flagged as unbootable instead of letting the resolver `ArgumentError` crash the whole listing.

Regression tests (`test/apps/app_namespace_it_test.dart`, group `gh-1614 I2/I3`):

- `a torn live-tile app (entry present, tile entry lost) lists the missing-files state naming the tile path` — failed before the fix (`error` was null).
- `the tile entry vanishing after a clean scan flags the tile on the next scan (cache-hit path)` — failed before the fix.
- `a live-tile app with both entries present lists clean` — guards over-flagging.
- `a live-tile entry name that cannot resolve in the namespace flags the tile instead of crashing the listing`.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

# BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

**Fixed.** `listApps` now probes every launch surface's boot entry, the live-tile one included:

- New `AppsStore._missingBootEntry(id, {tileEntry})` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) probes `AppStorage.entryPath(id)` (the full-app entry) **and**, when the parsed model declares a `"widget"` section, `AppStorage.entryPath(id, tileWidget.entry)` — the exact path `AppTileHost` boots (`app.tileWidgetPath`). The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).
- Both scan paths are covered: the fresh-parse path probes against the parsed model, and the **manifest-hash cache-hit path** now probes the tile entry via `cached.tileWidget` too — a tile entry lost *after* a clean scan still flags on the next scan.
- A manifest declaring an entry that cannot resolve in the namespace (`"entry": "../evil.js"`) is flagged as unbootable instead of letting the resolver `ArgumentError` crash the whole listing.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

Covered on both scan paths: fresh parse **and** the manifest-hash cache-hit path (via `cached.tileWidget`). A manifest declaring an unresolvable entry name (`"../evil.js"`) is flagged as unbootable instead of crashing the listing with a resolver `ArgumentError`.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.

Missing coverage added (`test/apps/apps_store_test.dart`, new group `AppsStore catalog install namespace guard (gh-1614 rework)`):

- `installWidget rejects a hostile archive entry name before any write` — drives `installWidget(files: {'../evil.js': …})` to an `ArgumentError`, asserts nothing was written outside the namespace and no install record landed (the previously untested hostile-entry rejection).
- `installWidget rejects a manifest i18n ref that cannot resolve in the namespace with the honest i18n message` — failed before the fix (raw `ArgumentError`).
- `installWidget still fails a DANGLING valid ref with the missing message` — pins the unchanged all-or-nothing contract.

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(

    'valid in-namespace path',
```

{"content":"# Thread 1 — ⚠️ IMPORTANT → probe gap: live-tile entries are not bootability-checked

**Fixed.** `listApps` now probes every launch surface's boot entry, the live-tile one included:

- New `AppsStore._missingBootEntry(id, {tileEntry})` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) probes `AppStorage.entryPath(id)` (the full-app entry) **and**, when the parsed model declares a `"widget"` section, `AppStorage.entryPath(id, tileWidget.entry)` — the exact path `AppTileHost` boots (`app.tileWidgetPath`). The message goes through the existing `_missingEntryMessage(id, entry:)`, so the missing-files state now names the tile path (`apps/<id>/widget_tile.js`).

{"content":"# Thread 2 — 💡 SUGGESTION: install-side i18n-ref rejection is inconsistent with the read side

**Fixed — took the first alignment (honest, consistent message); kept `_segmentPattern` as is.**

`AppsStore._validateI18nRefs` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/apps_store.dart`) now checks `AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)` **before** touching the resolver and throws the designed i18n-shaped `StateError`:

```dart
if (!AppStorage.isValidRelativePath(ref)) {
  throw StateError(
    'install of $id rejected: manifest i18n ref "$ref" is not a '
    'valid in-namespace path',
  );
}
```

- Same message contract as the dangling-ref rejection (`manifest i18n ref "…" is missing from the widget package`), so an update archive omitting a space/non-ASCII-named ref now fails with the honest reason instead of the raw `path "…" cannot be resolved under apps/<id>/` validator text.
- `_segmentPattern` stays narrow on purpose: the read side (`_withI18nContents`) skips such refs like missing files, so widening it would install refs that silently never render; a ref shipped in the archive still installs (the `files.containsKey(ref)` short-circuit precedes the check), matching the suggested patch.
